findings: HABS MT-39-H drawings, sheets 1–2 (drawn 1976, checked 1977), depict the altered HS19 barn; 1974 photo H-2 provides log, chinking, shingle and plank-gable form.
Drawing note assigns garage conversion to 1928; nomination says 1920/1920s. Both establish that its garage doors and concrete floor are too late.
Lean-to chronology conflicts: drawing places it before garage conversion; nomination assigns it to that conversion. Exclude the lean-to rather than resolve this without evidence.
Nomination printed page 24 dates stallion barns to circa 1870s and describes log joints, lime daubing, wood shingles, plank gables, loft/feed rooms and original stone foundations with log sills.
Modern concrete foundations, window plastic, stovepipe, garage doors and reconstructed/current fencing cannot be treated as original period evidence.
Nomination printed pages 11–13 documents early jack-leg fencing and late nineteenth-century barn/corral groups; no exact paddock layout claimed.
Wood Handbook chapter 2 printed pages 2–13/14 and 2–17 describe natural pine and redcedar colour; these are material analogues, not recovered barn pigments.
